results.intentUsed: This is a weekly report page. Work through these checks and record exactly what you observe: 1. Read the small comparison text under each headline number (for example the '+12% vs last week' line) and state whether it is comfortably legible against the white card, or too faint to read. 2. Read the 'Summary of the week' cell for the first agent and state whether the full sentence is readable or visibly cut off mid-sentence, and whether any indication such as an ellipsis or expand control is offered. 3. Scroll to the very bottom of the page and state whether the fixed bar holding 'Export CSV' and 'Send to stakeholders' covers any table content.
